description.en: Map a host folder for bidirectional file transfer; ideal for large downloads.
description.zh: 映射主机文件夹进行双向文件传输，适合大文件下载存储。

description.en: Check documents in a read-only mapped folder to prevent changes to host files.
description.zh: 在只读映射的文件夹中查看文档，防止沙盒改写主机原始文件。

description.en: vGPU + Network + Clipboard. High performance for running complex software.
description.zh: 启用硬件加速、网络与剪贴板。适合运行和测试高性能软件。

description.en: Maximum security: no network, no sharing, protected client. For malware analysis.
description.zh: 最高安全：无网络、无共享且开启 RDP 保护。用于分析可疑程序。

description.en: Isolated browsing with Edge; downloaded files automatically sync to host downloads.
description.zh: 在隔离环境中使用 Edge 冲浪；下载的文件将自动同步至主机目录。

description.en: Install apps from host library to sandbox; prevents host registry pollution.
description.zh: 从主机软件库安装程序到沙盒，防止捆绑软件污染宿主机。
默认 Windows 沙盒设置
